title: Neural network on RNA-binding protein genes diagnoses non-obstructive azoospermia
summary: Machine learning selection (LASSO, SVM-RFE, Boruta) on 58 GEO testicular samples identified DDX20 and NCBP2 as predictors of non-obstructive azoospermia, and an artificial neural network built on their expression was developed as a diagnostic model. Validation used three public GEO datasets and 44 local clinical samples (27 control, 17 NOA). Samples are small and the result concerns diagnostic markers, not mechanism.
ai_technology: LASSO, SVM-RFE and Boruta gene selection and an artificial neural network diagnostic model on DDX20 and NCBP2 expression

evidence.tested: Three public GEO datasets and 44 local clinical samples used for validation of the model; retrospective expression data.
evidence.unknown: Larger cohorts, mechanism, and performance outside the sampled hospital; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Selects predictive genes and builds the neural network classifier.

source_review.scope: Abstract read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI; author affiliations from Europe PMC or Crossref. Full text not accessed.
